officialRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5700 / Intel discrete GPU equivalent

knownFixes.issue: Game freezes at initial helicopter cutscene
knownFixes.fix: Update NVIDIA drivers to 610.43.02 or newer. Use Proton 11.0 Beta or GE-Proton11-1.

knownFixes.issue: Game crashes on startup with vkCreateComputePipelines assertion
knownFixes.fix: Install GE-Proton11-1. Add launch options: PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU=0 PROTON_FORCE_NVAPI=1 VKD3D_DISABLE_EXTENSIONS=VK_EXT_mesh_shader,VK_NV_raw_access_chains VKD3D_CONFIG=pipeline_library_app_cache DXVK_ASYNC=1 WINE_VIDEO_DECODER=software %command%

knownFixes.issue: Open world freeze / cutscene video freeze
knownFixes.fix: Install vcrun2019 and corefonts via protontricks (Denuvo DRM check fails without core fonts)

knownFixes.issue: Game doesn't like more than 32 cores / 64 threads

knownFixes.fix: Use Mulderland's Enhancement Pack or Ultimate-ASI-Loader with mod

notes: I didn't get past the initial video. Same issue as a lot of people. No amount of tweaking or changing proton version, etc. would get me past the freeze in the helicopter scene.

For my hardware i expected the game to be extremely sluggish but was absolutely suprised to see 80+ FPS at Medium graphic settings! Game was unable to get past the initial helicopter cutscene before crashing, updating my graphics drivers to 610.43.02 resolved the issue and then the game performed as intended.
Crashes after a few moments of starting game. Follow the steps listed here to install and build Pyroveil (resolved my issues).
Starts, but freezes/crashes at helicopter section with NVIDIA Xid 109. 595.84 did not fix it. Tried Proton 10, Experimental, Hotfix, 11 beta and GE-Proton. Still crashes every time.

After significant troubleshooting, got the game fully working. Game has two separate issues: vkCreateComputePipelines assertion crash on startup, and cutscene video freeze. Both fixed by using GE-Proton11-1 specifically.
Getting the game going can be a challenge. But once its up and running its a good experience. Loading save freezes on black screen on first launch.
At first, the game would freeze indefinitely at the intro scene. After switching to Proton 11 beta, this was fixed. Then, the game would randomly freeze at some save points until I shut it down.
Game Runs Great for me. Once when I alt-TAB to get out of the game and came back the control was stuck in the watch view, but doing alt-TAB again fixed it.
Turn off Vsync and DLSS. There is still occasional freezing but im getting 100fps in 1440p

notes: Much, MUCH better than I expected. The story is well written, and the atmosphere and presentation are top-notch throughout most of the game. Visually, the game looks really good.
Waited for Path Tracing - and it looks AMAZING.
Quite a looker too, with path tracing enabled, but reaaaally heavy to run.

Now let me say first and formost this is not a hitman game. The levels are a lot more linear, with a lot less variety in ways you can solve the pronblems. That being said, the ways they do give you are excellent and I would highly recommend.
